facts.title: About the hotel
facts.text: The Banyan Grove is a 48-room boutique hotel in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, built around a 90-year-old banyan tree in its central courtyard. It opened in 2016 and is rated four stars.

facts.title: Address
facts.text: The hotel address is 14 Ulsoor Lake Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038, India.

facts.title: Contact details
facts.text: You can reach the front desk on +91 80 4567 1200 or email stay@banyangrove.example.

facts.title: Languages spoken
facts.text: Front desk staff speak English, Hindi, Kannada and Tamil.

facts.title: Room categories
facts.text: The hotel has four room categories: Garden View Queen, Deluxe King, Executive Twin and the Banyan Suite.

facts.title: Garden View Queen
facts.text: The Garden View Queen is 280 sq ft with one queen bed and a courtyard view. It sleeps a maximum of 2 adults and starts at INR 5,800 per night.

facts.title: Deluxe King
facts.text: The Deluxe King is 340 sq ft with one king bed and a private balcony. It sleeps 2 adults plus 1 child under 12 on existing bedding, and starts at INR 7,400 per night.

facts.title: Executive Twin
facts.text: The Executive Twin is 400 sq ft with two double beds and sleeps up to 3 adults. It starts at INR 8,900 per night and is the smallest room that comfortably accommodates three guests.

facts.title: Banyan Suite
facts.text: The Banyan Suite is 620 sq ft with a separate living room, a king bed and a sofa bed. It sleeps up to 4 adults and starts at INR 13,500 per night.

facts.title: In-room amenities
facts.text: Every room has air conditioning, a 43-inch smart TV, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, a tea and coffee maker, a mini-fridge, an in-room safe and blackout curtains.

facts.title: Extra beds
facts.text: An extra bed or rollaway costs INR 1,500 per night and can only be added to the Executive Twin and the Banyan Suite.

facts.title: Connecting rooms
facts.text: Two pairs of connecting Garden View Queen rooms are available on the second floor, subject to request at the time of booking.

facts.title: Swimming pool
facts.text: Yes, there is an outdoor rooftop swimming pool. It is open daily from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM and is complimentary for in-house guests.

facts.title: Pool rules
facts.text: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult in the pool. There is no lifeguard on duty, and swimwear is required.

facts.title: Fitness centre
facts.text: The fitness centre on level 1 is open 24 hours and is free for in-house guests. It has cardio machines, free weights and a stretching area.

facts.title: Spa
facts.text: Grove Spa is open from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM and offers Ayurvedic and Swedish therapies. Appointments must be booked in advance.

facts.title: Wi-Fi
facts.text: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel with no device limit and no time restriction.

facts.title: Meeting rooms
facts.text: There are two meeting rooms seating 12 and 30 people. They cost INR 4,000 per hour including a projector, screen and whiteboard.

facts.title: Parking
facts.text: Complimentary valet parking is available with 20 spaces, including two EV charging points.

facts.title: Laundry
facts.text: Same-day laundry and dry cleaning is available if items are handed in before 9:00 AM. The service is chargeable and priced per item.

facts.title: Restaurant
facts.text: Tamarind is the all-day dining restaurant at the hotel, open from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM, serving South Indian and Continental cuisine.

facts.title: Breakfast
facts.text: Yes, buffet breakfast is included in every room rate. It is served at Tamarind from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM daily.

facts.title: Bar
facts.text: The Aerial Bar on the rooftop is open from 4:00 PM to 11:30 PM and serves cocktails, Indian craft beer and small plates.

facts.title: Room service
facts.text: In-room dining is available from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Room service is not offered overnight.

facts.title: Dietary requirements
facts.text: Vegetarian, vegan, Jain and gluten-free menus are available on request. Please tell the restaurant about nut allergies in advance.

facts.title: Check-in time
facts.text: Check-in starts at 2:00 PM.

facts.title: Check-out time
facts.text: Check-out is at 11:00 AM.

facts.title: Early check-in and late check-out
facts.text: Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability. Late check-out until 2:00 PM is complimentary for suite guests; for other rooms it is charged at 50 percent of the nightly rate.

facts.title: Cancellation policy
facts.text: Cancellation is free up to 48 hours before 2:00 PM on the check-in date. Inside 48 hours, one night of room charge applies. A no-show is charged the first night of the stay in full.

facts.title: Peak-season cancellation
facts.text: For stays between 20 December and 5 January, cancellations require 7 days notice. Inside 7 days those bookings are non-refundable.

facts.title: Payment methods
facts.text: The hotel accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UPI and cash up to INR 20,000. A card pre-authorisation is taken at check-in.

facts.title: Identification required
facts.text: A government-issued photo ID is required for every adult at check-in. Foreign nationals must present a passport and a valid visa.

facts.title: Children
facts.text: Children under 6 stay free on existing bedding. Children aged 6 to 12 are charged INR 1,000 per night, which includes breakfast.

facts.title: Pets
facts.text: Pets are not permitted at the hotel. Certified service animals are welcome at no extra charge.

facts.title: Smoking
facts.text: The hotel is entirely non-smoking indoors. A designated smoking terrace is on level 4. Smoking in a room incurs an INR 10,000 deep-cleaning fee.

facts.title: Quiet hours
facts.text: Quiet hours are from 10:30 PM to 7:00 AM across all floors.

facts.title: Taxes on room rates
facts.text: Room rates are exclusive of GST. GST is charged at 12 percent for rooms up to INR 7,500 per night and 18 percent above that.

facts.title: Airport distance and transfer
facts.text: Kempegowda International Airport is about 38 km away, a 60 to 90 minute drive. The hotel does not run a complimentary shuttle, but a paid airport transfer can be arranged from INR 2,200 for a sedan.

facts.title: Metro and public transport
facts.text: Indiranagar Metro station on the Purple Line is 900 metres away, about a 12 minute walk.

facts.title: Nearby attractions
facts.text: Ulsoor Lake is 1.5 km away, the 100 Feet Road shopping and restaurant strip is 600 metres away, and UB City is about 6 km away.

facts.title: Front desk and concierge
facts.text: The front desk and concierge are staffed 24 hours a day and can arrange taxis, restaurant reservations and local tours.

facts.title: Accessibility
facts.text: The hotel has a step-free entrance and lift access to all floors. Two accessible Garden View Queen rooms, 104 and 105, have roll-in showers and grab rails.

facts.title: Luggage storage
facts.text: Complimentary luggage storage is available both before check-in and after check-out.

facts.title: Doctor on call
facts.text: A doctor is on call 24 hours a day. The consultation is chargeable and billed to the room.

facts.title: Group bookings
facts.text: Bookings of more than 8 rooms are handled by the sales team. Please email groups@banyangrove.example for a group quotation.

facts.title: Private events
facts.text: The rooftop lawn can be hired for private events of up to 60 guests. The events team can be reached through the front desk.

facts.title: Booking modifications
facts.text: Dates on an existing booking can be changed once free of charge if the request is made more than 48 hours before check-in and the new dates have availability.
